limits: Gala is an original CQC design for young Solid Snake from original PS1 MGS1; it is not attested as a reproduction of the released official tuxedo unlock.

Forty-two native drawings are preserved across four unchanged PNGs; each face has42 temporal frames sharing semantically appropriate keyposes. No extracted animation cycle or absolute1:1 body-model fidelity is claimed.

Both old backward/high kick index7 figures are excluded from all runtime actions. Four genuinely drawn forward low phases perface replace them without changing original gameplay mappings, phase indices, FPS or counts.

The grenade deploy gesture uses empty-hand reach/release bodies8/9; no grenade held during preparation is drawn. The separate engine projectile appears from the reviewed hand socket, and no SOCOM pose is relabeled as grenade deployment.
All PNG bytes and weak-alpha fringe are retained; exact source-pixel Canvas compound contours exclude adjacent bodies and low-alpha background without raster rewriting.

The new left page calibration figure is a flexed guarded stance. Its upright-equivalent source stature is an anatomical estimate crosschecked against the accepted right neutral and must be reviewed in final UI/match; its504px bbox is not asserted to be standing stature.
Source art/geometry admission is separate from final live preview, match and production delivery verification.
